title: ASB: street drinkers outside a shop, ongoing nuisance

caller.name: Margaret Hobbs
caller.persona: elderly, polite, weary, has rung about this before, a little rambling
caller.openingLine: Oh hello, yes. It's the drinkers again, outside the Premier shop on the corner. There's five or six of them tonight, shouting and swearing, and one of them keeps kicking the bin over. It's every evening now, you know.
dontKnowLines: Oh, I wouldn't know that, dear.

incident.summaryTruth: Regular caller Margaret Hobbs, 71, reports five to six street drinkers outside the Premier store on Tarring Road, Worthing, shouting, swearing and kicking a bin over. Ongoing nightly issue. No violence tonight, no weapons, nobody threatened directly. Caller is watching from her flat across the road and is not in danger. She has called three times this month. The group usually disperses by ten. Known local issue.

facts.label: Caller's name
facts.beat: Margaret Hobbs. H-O-B-B-S. You've probably got me on your system, I've rung before.

facts.label: Location
facts.beat: The Premier on Tarring Road, the corner shop. I'm in the flats just across the road.

facts.label: Group size
facts.beat: Five or six of them tonight. Sometimes it's more at the weekend.

facts.label: Behaviour
facts.value: shouting, swearing, kicking the bin over
facts.beat: Shouting and swearing mostly, terrible language. And the big one keeps kicking the litter bin over. No fighting tonight, not yet anyway.

facts.label: Anyone directly threatened
facts.beat: Oh no, not at me, they don't know I'm watching. People are just crossing the road to avoid them.

facts.label: Ongoing pattern
facts.value: every evening, third call this month
facts.beat: Every evening this month, more or less. This is my third time ringing. The nice lady last time said someone would come but nobody ever does, you know.

facts.label: Caller's own safety
facts.value: in her flat across the road, not in danger
facts.beat: I'm quite safe, dear, I'm up in my flat with the door locked. I just watch from the window.
